def: The one sentence that opens a write-up and states the budget, the effect with its interval and seeds, the held-out share and an integrity statement.
Weco AI's four conditions for credible improvement: a fair human baseline, a sustained multi-step trend, generalisation beyond the optimised measurement and a fixed physical budget.
A finding that an expected effect did not appear, a check failed or a method did not work, reported as information.
The six-part report shape: claim, replication, extension, negative results, integrity details and reproduction.
A single command that regenerates the headline figure from the stored records.
A confidence interval from resampling the observed values with replacement many times.
